description: Projected first-innings total for a men's T20, with a p10-p90 band, from the score you send. On 107 men's T20 internationals played after all its training data (1 Jul to 17 Sep 2026): median error 18.6 runs with a ground named and 18.5 without, and the final total fell inside the band 80% and 82% of the time. Per call.

balls_bowled.description: Legal balls bowled, as a scorecard counts them: 1-120, and 12.3 overs = 75.

venue.description: The ground's name as scorecards write it; the answer says which ground was used.

wickets.description: Wickets lost (0-10). At 10, or at 120 balls, the answer is the score itself.

name: hsh-cricket-parscore
